jobs.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Cobalt Bank is hiring a Senior Network Security Engineer for our Austin hub (hybrid, 3 days onsite).

Responsibilities:
- Own firewall policy, segmentation and secure connectivity for branch and data centre networks
- Partner with the SOC on incident response for network-borne threats
- Drive the bank's Zero Trust roadmap

Required Skills:
- 6+ years in network engineering with a security focus
- Deep hands-on BGP, OSPF and VLAN design
- Firewall administration (Palo Alto or Cisco ASA) and Cisco ISE
- Zero Trust and microsegmentation experience
- Bachelor's degree in a technical field

Preferred:
- SD-WAN migration experience
- Splunk or other SIEM familiarity
- CCNP or CISSP

We will sponsor and transfer H1B visas for exceptional candidates.
